# Hallmark Studio

> Web design and SEO agency for Essex small businesses, based in Chelmsford.

Hallmark Studio builds custom websites and manages local SEO for small businesses across Essex. Founded by Cormac and Mohamod. Every project is handled directly by the founders — no account managers, no handoffs.

## Services

- **Web Design** — Custom, mobile-first websites from £999 one-off. No templates. Built to rank on Google.
- **SEO & Google** — Local SEO management and Google Business Profile optimisation from £199/month.
- **Free Audit** — Free 15-minute audit of your website and Google listing. No obligation.

## Pricing

- Starter: £199/month — Google Business Profile management
- Growth: £399/month — Website build included + monthly SEO
- Pro: £799/month — Full local SEO campaign
- Website Only: £999 one-off — Custom website, no ongoing plan

## About

- Based in Chelmsford, Essex, UK
- Serving businesses across Chelmsford, Colchester, Southend-on-Sea, Brentwood, Basildon, and wider Essex
- 60-day walk-away guarantee on all plans
